7 DAYS. YOUR KIND OF DISCOVERY.

Every day,
a new perspective.

A day-by-day starting point, with room for the moments you never planned.

01DAY 01Arrival and first impressions+

Arrive and recover from travel near Colombo or Negombo. Keep the afternoon open for a short coastal or city stroll rather than a lengthy transfer.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Easy first daylocal welcome
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTColombo / Negombo
02DAY 02The road to Kandy+

Travel toward Kandy through changing tropical scenery. Visit Peradeniya Royal Botanic Gardens if time permits, then enjoy the lakeside city in the late afternoon.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Peradeniya optionKandy Lakehill gateway
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTKandy
03DAY 03Waterfalls and tea country+

Follow the scenic highland road toward Nuwara Eliya, making time for a tea-estate visit or a Ramboda-area waterfall viewpoint. Evenings are cooler at this elevation.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Ramboda corridortea factoryNuwara Eliya
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTNuwara Eliya
04DAY 04The journey to Ella+

Continue across tea country. Where schedules and ticketing allow, substitute part of the road transfer with a scenic train journey from the Nanu Oya area toward Ella.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Highland train optionalviewsElla arrival
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTElla
05DAY 05Ella at your own pace+

Photograph Nine Arch Bridge from an appropriate public viewpoint and walk Little Adam's Peak if the weather and mobility suit. Leave the afternoon open for tea, cafes or a nearby waterfall stop.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Nine Arch BridgeLittle Adam's PeakRavana area
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTElla
06DAY 06Haputale and the green hills+

Head west through Haputale's tea-growing landscape. An early Lipton's Seat outing is an option before continuing toward Belihuloya for a quieter highland evening.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
HaputaleLipton's Seat optionalforested hills
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTBelihuloya
07DAY 07Back toward Colombo+

Return toward Colombo or the airport by road. Allow substantial transfer time and adjust the final overnight if the flight departs early the following morning.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Scenic returnonward flight
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTDeparture

Suggested pacing and overnight areas. Day order and stops can change with arrival times, weather, access and your preferred pace.

THE LITTLE DETAILS MATTER

Thoughtfully planned.
Ready to make yours.

This is a flexible trip concept, rather than a confirmed departure or booking. We’ll shape the practical details around your dates and preferences.

Dates & weather+

Match the regions and experiences with your travel dates. Beach, surf and wildlife conditions vary across the island.

Access & activities+

Attraction access, park blocks, guides, vehicle availability, rail seats and optional activities are confirmed during planning.

Your pace+

Climbs, early starts, walking demands and road transfers can be adjusted around your mobility, interests and comfort.

Price & inclusions+

No fixed package price, hotel category, meals, guide services or admission tickets are included or confirmed by this outline.

Thoughtful travel+

Respect sacred places, communities and wildlife. Animal sightings and sea-based activities are never guaranteed.
